primitives.subtask: Email the transaction count to alex.rivera@gmail.com, subject 'Note about expendings'

steps.action: Type “Note about expendings” in the “Subject” field

Type “[navigate_by_route]: Check that agent navigates to the Transactions section on SecureBank Online.

[filter_by_date_range]: Check that agent filters credit card transactions for the year 2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31).

[count_entries]: Check that agent reads and counts the total number of credit card transactions displayed for 2026.

[carry_info_cross_site]: Check that agent preserves the counted transaction total and navigates to WebMail.

[create_by_form]: Check that agent opens the Compose window in WebMail to start a new email.

[message_from_free_text]: Check that agent sends an email to alex.rivera@gmail.com with subject "Note about expendings" and body "The total number of credit card transactions for 2026 is 1161".” in the “Write your message...” field
